geopolitics_summary: US-Iran escalation and Hormuz diplomacy collapse heighten crude/LNG supply risk; EU nuclear constrained by climate; US LNG export growth may moderate TTF upside.

themes.headline: US-Iran military escalation; Trump promises further strikes on Iran
themes.why_it_matters: Hormuz closure risk directly constrains global LNG supply to EU. Higher crude/oil prices reduce power generation fuel-switching benefit; tightens gas arb to LNG, supporting TTF floor.

themes.headline: Europe nuclear capacity threatened by rising temperatures and cooling constraints
themes.why_it_matters: Nuclear outages (forced or derated) during summer heat reduce baseload supply; pushes power prices up and gas into power-gen. Direct DA spread and seasonal Cal+1 risk on Nordic/CEE.

themes.headline: US LNG exports rose 23% H1 2026 to 17.4 Bcf/d; higher capacity utilization
themes.why_it_matters: Higher US LNG supply increases arbitrage flows to NW Europe, pressures TTF downside and reduces near-term gas-to-power premium. Cal+1 / winter storage fill accelerated.

themes.headline: Power-hungry EU data centers expanding; local opposition and zoning delays grow
themes.why_it_matters: Persistent structural demand growth in power (AI/cloud) supports bull case for power and carbon. Delays or denials increase grid stress risk; upside DA spreads, especially CEE/AT.

themes.headline: Libya targets European energy void amid Hormuz risk and rising production
themes.why_it_matters: If Libya stabilizes crude/condensate export, reduces Hormuz single-point-of-failure premium and LNG supply urgency. Lower crude prices, weaker fuel-switch appeal, bearish near-curve power.

watchlist: von der Leyen State of the Union speech — likely to signal climate/AI investment urgency; watch for power demand/carbon price rhetoric.
Hormuz chokepoint escalation trajectory — track strait closures, sanctions scope, LNG force majeure announcements (weekly).
US LNG nameplate additions Q3–Q4 2026 — additional Bcf/d online; monitor for TTF backwardation compression.
EU data center permitting decisions (Austria, Netherlands) — regulatory clarity on power supply commitments may unlock demand acceleration.
